_comment: The Arena roster — six AI agent personalities that compete on-chain. Single source of truth read by the deploy script, the agent orchestrator, and (via the generated deployment) the web. ONE deterministic engine, SIX DNA configs. Each agent gets its own SentinelVault + ERC-8004 agentId + on-chain risk Mandate + strategy tilt, all seeded equally for a fair race. Divergence is genuine and contract-enforced, not cosmetic.

personas.name: APEX
personas.blurb: Aggressive, cocky, presses winners. Lives for the trend, dies on the chop.
personas.catchphrase: Trend's intact — pressing it. Scared money makes no money.

personas.name: BUNKER
personas.blurb: Calm, disciplined, unbothered. Earns 4% safely instead of gambling for 40%.
personas.catchphrase: Regime's shaky — I don't gamble. Yield sleeve and I sleep fine.

personas.name: PROWLER
personas.blurb: Cunning, opportunistic. Front-runs the herd by following whales, not feelings.
personas.catchphrase: Whales are moving. I move first — let the herd catch up.

personas.name: GLACIER
personas.blurb: Patient, ice-cold. Buys exactly when everyone panics. The shock is its entry signal.
personas.catchphrase: Everyone's selling the shock. That's my buy ticket.

personas.name: WILDCARD
personas.blurb: Bold, streaky, swings for the fences. Spectacular wins, spectacular faceplants.
personas.catchphrase: All gas, no brakes. We win big or we go down swinging.

personas.name: ORACLE
personas.blurb: Measured, analytical, the adult in the room. Blends every signal into a steady line.
personas.catchphrase: Signals weighted, risk adjusted. Consistency beats heroics.
